typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Site Alias} as string,
		{Asset Alias} as string,
		Asset_ID__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName,
		AssetID = left(trim(replace(Asset_ID__c, toString('''), toString(''))), 6)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ETLUser as string,
		sitealias as string,
		assetalias as string,
		AssetID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		ETLUser,
		sitealias = {Site Alias},
		assetalias = {Asset Alias},
		AssetID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
